card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a middle piece of a newly coined brand drug name, such as the Z in IMFINZI or SEM in CRESEMBA. It appears in drug-label text where the brand name is being spelled out in pieces.

modes.label: Brand name, middle or last piece
modes.description: A piece inside an uncommon brand name for an oncology or anti-infective drug, usually just before the final letters.
modes.example: Weight < 30 kg: Neoadjuvant: IMFIN<<Z>>I 20 mg/kg in combination

modes.label: Other brand names
modes.description: Middle pieces of other brand names, often followed by 'therapy', 'and', or a dose.
modes.example: During concomitant use of SYMB<<RA>>VO and methotrexate, monitor

card.writes: It suggests the pole helps finish the rest of a brand name, with a bias against common word starts like rod, alg and pit.
card.plain: It lights up partway through an invented brand drug name, such as IMFINZI, before the name ends.
